WITH rating_stats AS (
  SELECT rating,
    AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost,
    AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_per_day_rental_price
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
),
global_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_per_day_rental_price) AS overall_per_day_average
  FROM rating_stats
)
SELECT r.rating,
  r.avg_replacement_cost,
  r.avg_per_day_rental_price,
  r.avg_per_day_rental_price / g.overall_per_day_average AS per_day_price_ratio
FROM rating_stats r
CROSS JOIN global_avg g;
